newsitem.title: USA: High cotton prices trigger import quota - USDA.
newsitem.headline: High cotton prices trigger import quota - USDA.

text.p: High cotton prices have triggered another special quota permitting entry of 44,251,545 kilograms (97,558,037 lbs), the U.S. Department of Agriculture said Thursday.
The quota, being established on June 16, 1997, applies to cotton purchased not later than Sept 13, 1997 and entered into the United States not later than Dec 12, 1997, USDA said.
The quota amount is for the period Jan 1997 through March 1997.
